notes.title: *MAJOR UPDATE 1*
notes.content:
[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/37HighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

Hey guys! 

We are excited to release a big update we have been working on! This first major update includes a completely new level, 3 new secret areas, new minigames, lots of new features and bug fixes. 

Check out our new update release video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M7QXnRYjPxw

[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/HighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/a47HighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/5dfHighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/1bbHighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

[img]http://u.cubeupload.com/bennyboo1991/468HighresScreenshot000.png[/img]

Thank you guys so much for your support! 

We are hard at work on bringing you the next update. So stay tuned! :)

Ben

notes.title: New Level - Alpine Loft!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

[h1]The game has been updated with a completely new level, some new features, and bug fixes! [/h1]

[img]http://i.cubeupload.com/EROAm1.png[/img]

Here is a video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M7QXnRYjPxw

Have fun :)

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

It feels great to finally have the Steam community experiencing our game and giving us feedback! We have taken note of some minor bugs and requests and will have a patch out shortly to fix up some stuff and add some requested features!

some stuff we noted:
- New navigation methods, other than teleporting
- Even more game modes
- Customizable options, such as weapon grip angle
- Some experienced loading times in the elevator

[h1]We are working on a huge update for you guys right now with tons of new content! New levels to play, new weapons, an item shop, and so much more![/h1]

Thanks for all the support! 

You guys are awesome! <3

Ben
